t: This is 4 Chesterfield Gardens, a nineteenth-century house in Mayfair. It was commissioned by Charles Magniac, a financier and art collector who sat as a Liberal member of the House of Commons in two periods between 1868 and 1886. The architect was John Thomas Wimperis, who designed the house. Beyond that, there's little more to say with certainty, so take a moment to look at the facade and imagine the patron and his architect planning it together.
